description: Boundary and lifecycle coverage for property-graph definition, description and drop: describing a vertex-only graph, rejecting a definition with a duplicate label across two vertex tables, rejecting an edge whose key references a non-existent vertex table, describing a graph that was never defined, and re-creating a graph after it was dropped.

setup: CREATE TABLE Student(id BIGINT, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO Student VALUES (0,'Daniel')
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgmin VERTEX TABLES (Student PROPERTIES (id,name) LABEL Person)

cases.expected_output: Student	person	true	NULL	NULL	NULL	NULL	NULL	NULL	NULL	NULL

input.query: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH pgdup VERTEX TABLES (Student PROPERTIES (id,name) LABEL Person, School LABEL Person)

cases.expected_output:
error=constraint
message=Label person is not unique, make sure all labels are unique
